_about: Published PSX equity brokerage tariffs, for estimating charges when you don't enter the figures from your contract note. Commissions are negotiable and change: your signed commission sheet wins. Load with `portfolio.py broker import` (all) or `portfolio.py broker add NAME --preset KEY`. Edit this file or pass your own with --file.

_model.commission: For a trade at price P: find the first tier whose max_price >= P (or the last tier). Commission = the higher of per_share x qty and pct% x value, then at least min_commission per trade.
_model.sales_tax_pct: Provincial sales tax on the commission (goes into taxes).
_model.cvt_pct: Capital value tax on purchase value (goes into taxes, buys only).
_model.cdc_per_share: CDC handling per share (goes into other fees).
_model.levies_pct: PSX exchange fee + regulator levy, % of value (goes into other fees).

_regulation.minimum: PSX Regulations, Chapter 4, Annexure-III: ready-market equity commission at least 3 paisa per share or 0.15% of transaction value, whichever is greater, and at most 2.5%. Proprietary and sponsor/director/family trades are exempt from the minimum.

_defaults.notes: Sindh sales tax on brokerage 13% and CDC Rs 0.005/share per AKD's fee page; brokers in other provinces charge their province's rate. Exchange fee Rs 3.50 + regulator levy Rs 0.65 per Rs 100,000 traded (Desi Money Talk, Aug 2026). CVT on purchases reported as zero in Aug 2026; AKD's older fee page shows 0.01%: set cvt_pct if your contract note shows it.

finqalab.notes: One-time NCCPL account fee PKR 476 on the first deposit (finqalab.com FAQs). Orders: market, limit and stop-loss with a trigger price and a limit price (a sell stop protects a holding, a buy stop enters on a breakout). Stop-loss orders are valid for one day only (Finqalab's stop-loss tutorial, Dec 2024), so they must be placed again every trading day. No public API for placing orders.
